messages.subject: Fixed parameters in EFA
parts:
Hi there, 

I've been using the EFA functionality in lavaan and noticed that in the list output that (for what I assume is model identification reasons) the first loading on a second factor is always fixed, the first two loadings on a third factor are fixed,  and so on. 

What I'm trying to figure out is how lavaan gets standard errors on those fixed estimates in the final output? I have a particular use case where I get sandwich corrected standard errors using the delta matrix, but the delta matrix doesn't include columns for those fixed parameters from the EFA so I'm just trying to figure out if there's a way to either get a delta matrix for all parameters or recapitulate how lavaan gets standard errors for those initially fixed parameters. Example code below. 

Thanks!
 -Andrew

efa.model <- '
    efa("efa")*f1 +
    efa("efa")*f2 +
    efa("efa")*f3 =~ x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + x5 + x6 + x7 + x8 + x9
'
fit <- cfa(efa.model, data = HolzingerSwineford1939,std.lv=TRUE)

#includes SEs on f2=~x1 and f3=~x1+x2
summary(fit)

#libst object indicates these were fixed parameters
inspect(fit, "list")

#delta object also doesn't include those parameters
Delta <- lavInspect(fit, "delta")
